description: Readability score for any text — Flesch–Kincaid, Gunning fog index and more. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

text.description: English prose to score, at least 20 words. Scored with Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid, Gunning fog, SMOG, ARI and Coleman-Liau, which are averages over sentence and syllable counts, so a short passage gives a rough answer.
